DemographicInfo.Name: John
DemographicInfo.CulturalBackground: Man from the Midwest, raised in a family with three older sisters; cultural identity otherwise unspecified.
DemographicInfo.MigrationStatus: Lifelong Italian resident who relocated 400 miles from his hometown for work.

FamilySocialHistory.ChildhoodFamilyDynamics: Youngest of four with a six-year age gap; close family disrupted by the sudden death of his father at age 8, followed by financial stress and emotional distancing.
FamilySocialHistory.CurrentParentRelations: Maintains contact with his mother, who makes critical comparisons to his late father; sisters minimize his emotional concerns.
FamilySocialHistory.ChildhoodExperiences: After his father's death, academic performance declined, he withdrew from sports, and spent increasing time alone with video games and reading.
FamilySocialHistory.AbuseHistory: No abuse disclosed; emotional invalidation noted when the family discouraged discussion of grief.
FamilySocialHistory.SocialSupport: Limited support network primarily consisting of a concerned neighbor; minimal peer or family involvement in his current community.
FamilySocialHistory.SupportNetwork: Lives alone with occasional neighbor contact; family lives several hours away and provides limited emotional support.

EducationOccupation.EducationLevel: Completed high school after initially dropping out in his third year; briefly attended community college before withdrawing due to anxiety.
EducationOccupation.WorkHistory: Works night shifts at a small IT company in solitary roles; relocated when the company moved to a new city.
EducationOccupation.HousingStability: Stable housing, but home environment has become cluttered and poorly maintained due to low motivation and anxiety.
EducationOccupation.FinancialSituation: Income appears modest but stable; residual financial stress from past family loss, though no acute crisis reported.
EducationOccupation.HobbiesInterests: Historically enjoyed video games and reading; current engagement limited by fatigue and worry.

MainSymptoms: Physical anxiety symptoms (sweating, heart palpitations, diarrhea)
PsychologicalProfile.EmotionalReactions: Chronically anxious, easily overwhelmed, irritable, and embarrassed by symptoms; possible underlying sadness.
PsychologicalProfile.Aggressiveness: Denies self-harm or aggression; internalizes distress leading to neglect of personal needs.
PsychologicalProfile.SelfPerceptionIdentity: Sees himself as incapable of managing daily tasks and fears others’ judgment; internalizes family criticism.
PsychologicalProfile.SelfEsteem: Low self-esteem linked to perceived inadequacy, social withdrawal, and comparisons to his deceased father.
PsychologicalProfile.SenseOfSelfOthers: Views others as sources of potential scrutiny; interprets family responses as invalidating and relies on solitude for safety.

PsychologicalProfile.AttachmentStyle: Avoidant tendencies reinforced by early loss and critical family responses; limited ability to rely on others for support.
PsychologicalProfile.ExecutiveFunctioning: Organizational abilities impaired by anxiety-driven avoidance; struggles with completing instrumental activities of daily living.
PsychologicalProfile.Memory: Intact memory; no cognitive decline reported.
PsychologicalProfile.AttentionConcentration: Difficulty focusing at work during anxious episodes and restlessness.
PsychologicalProfile.SensoryPerception: No hallucinations or perceptual disturbances reported.
PsychologicalProfile.HigherCognitiveFunctions: Logical and reality-based thought processes despite anxious content.

CopingDefenses.Morality: Adheres to conventional moral values; conscientious toward others despite being overwhelmed.
